subtopic: Chemical Reactions of Carboxylic Acids
stem:
Arrange the following compounds in increasing order of their property as indicated:
(i) Acetaldehyde, Acetone, Di-\(tert\)-butyl ketone, Methyl \(tert\)-butyl ketone (reactivity towards HCN)
(ii) \(\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH(Br)COOH}\), \(\text{CH}_3\text{CH(Br)CH}_2\text{COOH}\), \((\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CHCOOH}\), \(\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}\) (acid strength)
(iii) Benzoic acid, 4-Nitrobenzoic acid, 3,4-Dinitrobenzoic acid, 4-Methoxybenzoic acid (acid strength)
_note: MIXED across the two half-chapters: part (i) is aldehyde/ketone reactivity while parts (ii) and (iii) are carboxylic-acid strength. Filed under the carboxylic-acid subtopic because two of the three parts are acid-strength comparisons, which NCERT teaches in section 8.9.1 (reactions involving cleavage of the O-H bond).

subtopic: Chemical Reactions of Aldehydes and Ketones
stem:
Complete each synthesis by giving missing starting material, reagent or products
(i) Ethylbenzene \(\xrightarrow[\text{KOH, heat}]{\text{KMnO}_4}\) ?
(ii) Benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid (phthalic acid) \(\xrightarrow[\text{heat}]{\text{SOCl}_2}\) ?
(iii) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CHO} \xrightarrow{\text{H}_2\text{NCONHNH}_2}\) ?
(iv) Benzene \(\xrightarrow{?}\) diphenylmethanone (benzophenone)
(v) 4-Oxocyclohexane-1-carbaldehyde \(\xrightarrow{[\text{Ag}(\text{NH}_3)_2]^{+}}\) ?
(vi) 2-Formylbenzoic acid \(\xrightarrow{\text{NaCN / HCl}}\) ?
(vii) \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CHO} + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO} \xrightarrow[\Delta]{\text{dil. NaOH}}\) ?
(viii) \(\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_2\text{COOC}_2\text{H}_5 \xrightarrow[\text{(ii) H}^{+}]{\text{(i) NaBH}_4}\) ?
(ix) Cyclohexanol \(\xrightarrow{\text{CrO}_3}\) ?
(x) Methylenecyclohexane \(\xrightarrow{?}\) cyclohexanecarbaldehyde
(xi) ? \(\xrightarrow[\text{(ii) Zn-H}_2\text{O}]{\text{(i) O}_3}\) 2 cyclohexanone
_note: The book prints all eleven items as drawn reaction schemes. Each drawn structure was read at 2.5x-3.5x zoom and rendered as an unambiguous name or formula so the stem stands alone: (i) a benzene ring bearing CH2CH3; (ii) a benzene ring with two ortho COOH groups; (iv) product is two rings joined by C=O; (v) a cyclohexane ring with =O and -CHO on carbons 1 and 4; (vi) a benzene ring with ortho -CHO and -COOH; (ix) a cyclohexane ring bearing -OH; (x) a cyclohexane ring with an exocyclic =CH2, product a cyclohexane ring bearing -CHO; (xi) product drawn as 2 x cyclohexanone.
